messages.subject: Breakage in TermsObject class in currently released version of Renjin ? (related to: Error: invalid attribute 'response' )
parts:
Hi.  I recently found your project and I'm really psyched to use it.  It seems to be a great concept.

Unfortunately,  I'm having some troubles that look like they might be related to a pervasive issue in the TermsObject class.
i filed a bug on this (#22 predict method applied to simple linear model causes "Error: invalid attribute 'response'" in Renjin Studio. @ https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/22 ).

However, I also noticed that this error seems to be arising on many of your unit tests... e.g., 

 >  http://packages.renjin.org/packages/rockchalk.html


thanks in advance 
 -chris
